name: orion-knowledge-atlas
description: Search, cite, and edit your local Orion Spaces from Claude.
long_description: A local bridge between Claude Desktop and Orion. Browse and search one Space at a time, open citation links in Orion, retrieve bounded source evidence, and directly create, edit, or delete notes without cloud sync or an API key.

tools.name: orion_list_spaces
tools.description: List Orion Spaces and content counts.

tools.name: orion_browse_space
tools.description: Browse note metadata in one explicit Space.

tools.name: orion_search
tools.description: Search notes and concepts within one Space.

tools.name: orion_get_note
tools.description: Read a note with its concepts, sources, and connections.

tools.name: orion_get_source
tools.description: Read bounded extracted text from a source.

tools.name: orion_create_note
tools.description: Create and immediately save an ordinary note in one Space.

tools.name: orion_update_note
tools.description: Directly edit supplied fields on an existing note.

tools.name: orion_delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note and clean its Space-scoped references.

vault_file.title: Orion vault
vault_file.description: Orion's local vault.json. The default is correct for a standard Orion installation.
